svg.title: Midnight Garden — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A clearly readable moonlit garden with an arched gate, stone path, fountain, lanterns, layered foliage, roses, and irises. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
